A torn paper strip emerges from the drawing and folds into a sharply constructed white paper staircase leading to the laptop screen. The screen has a subtle dark blue abstract geometric interface, no readable text. One graphite pencil crossing the lower paper establishes the sketching theme.
Bold asymmetric composition with large simple shapes and believable photographic cutouts. Entire laptop and paper staircase in the central two-thirds of the image so a 16:9 mobile crop keeps them visible. Deep petrol background with one broad butter-yellow paper plane, warm natural highlights, purposeful contact shadows, crisp tactile paper edges, detailed brushed metal, realistic camera optics. High-end handmade editorial collage, flat matte print aesthetic, subtle real paper surfaces but no fake ageing or artificial grain.
